I learned two things in high school civics: 

How government works—and to never help your buddy on an exam when your basketball coach has a paddle.

Louisiana living keeps you humble.

One minute you’re talking about great coffee by the lake—the next, there’s a rat snake on your deck acting like it owns the place.
